follow-up time: within the first 6 weeks of life
exposure: regional anesthesia during labor and delivery
outcome: brain morphology (frontal and occipital lobe volumes, cingulate gyrus volume)
cohort: The study involved 37 healthy infants, 24 exposed and 13 unexposed to regional anesthesia at delivery, who underwent high-resolution magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) within the first 6 weeks of life.
finding: Neonates exposed to maternal anesthesia had larger volumes in portions of the frontal and occipital lobes and cingulate gyrus compared to unexposed neonates.
followup_time: within the first 6 weeks of life
